about.title: One day.
about.description: For high school, college and university girls. Bring your curiosity and a team of 3. No professional experience needed.
about.organizers: Organised by NU ACM-W Student Chapter, the first ACM-W chapter in Kazakhstan and Central Asia.

whatIs.a: WHD is an annual team competition for girls with three rounds: mathematics, competitive programming and product design.

organizers.q: Who are the organisers of WHD?
organizers.a: NU ACM-W Student Chapter, the first ACM-W chapter in Kazakhstan and Central Asia. The chapter supports women in STEM and IT.

otherEvents.q: Are there any other events for girls?
otherEvents.a: Yes! CodeW is an individual programming contest. Code Girl Summer is a two-week web development camp. WISH is a 24-hour hackathon for women. Follow our Telegram and Instagram for details.

whoCanParticipate.a: Girls who are high school, college, and university students. Participation is in teams of 3 people.

professional.q: Do I need to be a professional?
professional.a: No, everyone interested in IT is welcome to participate.

noTeam.q: What if I don't have a team?
noTeam.a: You can find teammates in our <link href="https://t.me/WHD_chat">Telegram chat</link>.

howToParticipate.a: Sign up on this site with your email, fill in your details, and create a team of 3 people or join one with an invite link. Registration is open until November 12, 2026. Then come to Nazarbayev University on November 14, 2026.

online.a: No, Women’s Hack Day 2026 will be held offline at Nazarbayev University, Astana, Kazakhstan.

certificates.a: Yes! Winners get cash prizes and merch, participants get welcome packages, and there is a coffee break for everyone.

noAnswer.q: I didn't find an answer to my question. What should I do?
noAnswer.a: Join our <link href="https://t.me/WHD_chat">Telegram chat</link> and ask your questions there, or contact us via email: <link href="https://mail.google.com/mail/u/0/?fs=1&to=acm_w@nu.edu.kz&su&body&tf=cm">acm_w@nu.edu.kz.</link>
